rubric.statement: For an image input carried as a DSPy custom type, the outbound `user` message `content` is converted into a list of content blocks rather than left as one plain-text string with an embedded marker.

When a custom `Type` is serialized and its `format()` returns a list, DSPy JSON-serializes that list and wraps it between the reserved `CUSTOM_TYPE_START_IDENTIFIER` and `CUSTOM_TYPE_END_IDENTIFIER` markers.

`split_message_content_for_custom_types(...)` scans `user` message strings for those markers, converts surrounding substrings into `{"type": "text"}` blocks, parses the JSON inside each marker into content blocks, and assigns the resulting list back to `message["content"]`.
`dspy.Image.format()` emits an OpenAI-compatible image content part of the form `[{"type": "image_url", "image_url": {"url": image_url}}]`.
